$comment: AN-FCM-CLIENT (R1151, R1152, R204). The ONE home for the three things the Android push client and the server must agree on, read by BOTH sides of the join. web/tests/db/push-client-join.test.ts drives the REAL routes and the REAL reminder job with it: `registration.body` posted to POST /api/v1/devices, `optIn.body` to PATCH /api/v1/me, then runDailyReminders at `reminder.now` must hand a FakePushSender exactly `registration.fakeToken` with exactly `reminder.data`. android/app/src/test/kotlin/ch/monreleve/app/push/PushClientFixtureTest.kt requires the app's REAL request builders to produce `registration.body` (for `registration.fakeToken` and `registration.appVersion`) and `optIn.body`, and the app's REAL payload reader to read `reminder.data` as the reminder for `reminder.day`. `fakeToken` is what the app's FakePushTokens hands out - never a real registration token, and visibly not one. THE BODY CARRIES NO `platform`, deliberately: docs/api-v1.md section 10 makes it optional with default android, and the route REFUSES it - web/lib/entries/no-coordinates.ts matches banned keys as substrings and `platform` contains `lat`, so a body naming it answers 400 coordinates_refused (push-client-join.test.ts pins that, and REPORT-AN-FCM-CLIENT.txt records it as NOTICED).
